decision: Owner approval of the ADR 0002 containment gate for the local Codex agent profile, recorded 2026-08-14: proceed with the currently pinned Codex CLI 0.147.0-alpha.6.6 as re-pinned on branch a1/codex-cli-conformance. The accepted gaps listed below are acknowledged as-is. The compensating controls stand and remain mandatory: the materializer fails the attempt on any write-scope violation, the trusted verifier produces the authoritative diffs in a separate read-only checkout, and enrollment remains secret-free. No existing sandbox or profile rule is loosened or removed by this decision.
acceptedGaps: Codex CLI per-path enforcement gap: fine-grained per-path deny rules are not OS-enforced and are accepted as-is.
The Factory-owned Seatbelt sandbox layer is deferred to a later stage.
